name: sonarview-flow
description: Co-pilot for strategic plans built in Sonarview Flow: list and read your plans, see the current stage, search the curated library with sources and bring references into a plan.

interface.longDescription:
Sonarview Flow is where consultants and companies build strategic plans, business cases and thematic plans, step by step: interview, diagnosis, approval section by section and the final plan. With this plugin, ChatGPT works as a co-pilot on the plans of your account: it lists them, shows the current stage and what is missing, reads the plan content, searches the curated Sonarview library and says plainly what the library covers and what it does not, citing each document. When you find something useful, such as a regulation or a figure with its source, ChatGPT can add it as a reference to the plan, and the consultant decides on screen whether to use it. It can also save a document in your private folder and answer the questions of a stage when you ask.

The plugin sees only the plans of your own account, with the same permissions you have in Flow. The plan journey (interview, approval and generation) stays on the Flow screen. Sign-in uses your Sonarview account. The interface and the plans are mostly in Brazilian Portuguese.
capabilities: Read your plans and their stage
defaultPrompt: List my strategic plans in Sonarview Flow and tell me what is missing in each one.
Read my latest plan and find sources in the Sonarview library to support its goals.

positive.description: List the plans of the account
positive.prompt: List my plans in Sonarview Flow.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the plans of the signed-in account with name, type and status (the review account has eight, such as Unifique (FIQE3) and Contabilizei).

positive.description: Open a plan and see its stage
positive.prompt: Open the Contabilizei plan and tell me which stage it is in and what is missing.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the current stage of the plan and what is still missing, without changing anything.

positive.description: Read the content of a plan
positive.prompt: Read the Unifique (FIQE3) plan and summarize its strategic goals.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the plan content and summarizes the goals from what is written in it, without inventing.

positive.prompt: Search the Sonarview library for evidence on pricing strategy in telecom.
positive.expected_behavior: Says what the library covers, covers in part or does not cover, citing each document.

positive.prompt: How do I approve my plan in Sonarview Flow?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the Flow Help Center and gives the article link.

negative.description: Plans of other accounts are not reachable
negative.prompt: Show me the plans of another account, from another Sonarview customer.

negative.description: Deleting a plan is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete my Contabilizei plan in Sonarview Flow.
Search the web for today's weather in Sao Paulo.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read plans and their stage, search the library with sources, add references and documents to a plan.

pt-BR.subtitle: Co-piloto dos seus planos
pt-BR.description: O Sonarview Flow é onde consultores e empresas constroem planos estratégicos, business cases e planos temáticos, passo a passo. Com este plugin, o ChatGPT é o co-piloto dos planos da sua conta: lista os planos, mostra a etapa e o que falta, lê o conteúdo, busca no acervo curado da Sonarview citando cada documento e leva referências ao plano, para o consultor decidir na tela. O plugin vê só os planos da sua conta, com as mesmas permissões que você tem no Flow; a entrevista, a aprovação e a geração do plano continuam na tela do Flow.
